title: PhysxJointAPI (removed)
summary: Removed PhysX joint API that older assets still apply. Only physxJoint:maxJointVelocity is read for compatibility without a schema gate. Migrate it to newton:velocityLimit (NewtonJointAPI). Other physxJoint:* values remain ignored.
producer_scope: The explicit property-name selector publishes an authored legacy velocity on physics prims, with or without the removed API name; no current USD schema declares it.

columns.name: physxJoint:maxJointVelocity
columns.absent: Keep newton:velocityLimit, then FLT_MAX. Values below FLT_MAX override the Newton seed; finite per-axis PhysxJointAxisAPI limits take precedence.
columns.sentinel: FLT_MAX or inf means no legacy opinion.
columns.notes: Deprecated compatibility attribute, explicitly published when authored without requiring the removed PhysxJointAPI schema. Warn once and migrate to newton:velocityLimit (NewtonJointAPI). Other removed physxJoint properties remain ignored.

interactions.rule: Finite per-axis velocity limits override the finite Newton seed, which overrides the legacy joint limit. Armature and friction use PhysxJointAxisAPI or NewtonJointAPI only.

notes: The USD schema remains removed and the builders do not expose it. The compatibility velocity column is explicitly selected by name during population and read without requiring this API.
